```{python}
from pathlib import Path
import numpy as np
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

root=Path.cwd()
while not (root/'.unaltraweb/computations.yml').exists():
    if root==root.parent: raise RuntimeError('No es troba el projecte')
    root=root.parent
out=root/'assets/img/generated/temperatura-rendiment.svg'
out.parent.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
plt.rcParams.update({'font.family':'DejaVu Sans','font.size':12.5,'svg.fonttype':'none',
                     'axes.spines.top':False,'axes.spines.right':False})
air=np.linspace(20,45,100)
cell=np.linspace(25,75,100)
fig,axes=plt.subplots(1,2,figsize=(8.2,4.2),layout='constrained')
for wind,color in [(1.,'#990000'),(3.,'#003366')]:
    module=air+800/(25+6.84*wind)
    axes[0].plot(air,module,color=color,lw=2,label=f'Vent {wind:g} m/s')
axes[0].plot(air,air,':',color='#777777',label='Aire = mòdul')
axes[0].set(xlabel='Aire (°C)',ylabel='Mòdul (°C)')
axes[0].legend(frameon=False,fontsize=11.5)
relative=100*(1-.004*(cell-25))
axes[1].plot(cell,relative,color='#003366',lw=2)
axes[1].scatter([55],[88],color='#990000',zorder=3)
axes[1].annotate('55 °C → 88%',(55,88),xytext=(30,82),fontsize=12,
                 arrowprops={'arrowstyle':'-','color':'#777777'})
axes[1].set(xlabel='Cèl·lula (°C)',ylabel='Potència relativa (%)',ylim=(78,102))
assert np.isclose(100*(1-.004*(55-25)),88)
fig.savefig(out,facecolor='white',metadata={'Date':None})
plt.close(fig)
```
